description: 128 recorded episodes of an open 9B model on Scanner/NoWrap-v0 with the v0 interface (nested protocol object, regions as a string or a list): every tool call it issued, with the arguments as text exactly as it wrote them
lost_rule: answered with invalid_tool_call, or refused by the console for te_ms below its minimum, an unknown parameter or te_ms = null

arguments.expressions:
[
  "min_te_ms",  # console minimum for SE
  "sizeof(48, 96)",  # default for SE: 128 matrix, 240 FOV
  "48 * 0.02",  # check default area
  "240 / 128",  # default pixel size
  "240 / 96",   # phase-encode pixel size if matrix 96
]
